'''Polyquaternium-7''' was an [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] concoction used for numerous unusual beverages. The often-[[Carbon dioxide/Legends|carbonated]] mixture<ref name="CSWE" /> was,<ref name="VD" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> served at<ref name="VD" /> the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]], a [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall in the [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] of<ref name="CSWE2">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="CSWE2" /> The nightclub's central bar, staffed by [[Bartender/Legends|chief bartender]] [[Bufon Taire/Legends|Bufon Taire]],<ref name="CL" /> had a [[Polyquaternium-7 multicarbonator|polyquarternium-7 multicarbonator]] installed.<ref name="VD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Polyquaternium-7 was first mentioned&mdash;as part of the name of the polyquarternium-7 multicarbonator&mdash;in the [[2002]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]'', written by [[David West Reynolds (real person)|David West Reynolds]].<ref name="AOTCVD">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> The mixture was first established as an alcoholic ingredient and had its capitalization confirmed in the [[2008]] reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="CSWE" /> In the real world, [[Wikipedia:Polyquaternium-7|polyquaternium-7]] is a synthetic [[Wikipedia:Polymer|polymeric]] [[Wikipedia:Quaternary ammonium cation|quaternary ammonium salt]]. It is anti-static, film-forming, and is used as an ingredient in hair and nail care products.<ref name="CosmileEurope">{{WebCite|url=https://cosmileeurope.eu/inci/detail/12438/polyquaternium-7|text=POLYQUATERNIUM-7 – Ingredient - COSMILE Europe|author=COSMILE Europe|archivedate=20241202235853}}</ref>
